About these terms

These terms cover the Mass Reaction game for iPhone and this website, massreaction.app. The game is made by an independent developer, identified in our Privacy Policy and on the game’s App Store page (“we”, “us”). Questions? .

The game licence

Mass Reaction is distributed through the App Store. Unless its App Store page names a different licence, your use of the game is governed by Apple’s Standard End User License Agreement. These terms add to that agreement and do not replace it. Apple is not responsible for the game or its support; we are.

Optional purchases

The game is playable without paying. You can optionally buy packs of special balls through Apple’s in-app purchase system. The contents and price of each pack are shown in the game and confirmed by Apple before you pay.

Special balls are consumable: a ball is used up when you put it into play. Your stash is kept in the iCloud account of your Apple ID, so it follows you to other devices and survives reinstalling when iCloud is turned on. If iCloud is off, the stash exists only on that device and is lost if the game is deleted. Special balls have no cash value and cannot be exchanged or transferred.

Refunds for purchases billed by Apple are handled by Apple. You can request a refund through Apple. Nothing here limits the rights you have under consumer law.

Gifts and game changes

The game gives some special balls for free along the way. Which special balls appear, how often, and what is gifted or offered may change in updates as we balance the game.

The leaderboard

Mass Reaction has one shared Game Center leaderboard, and it includes runs played with special balls. Please play fair: scores obtained by cheating, modifying the game or exploiting bugs may be removed.

Using this website

You may browse this website and share links to it. Please do not try to compromise its security, disrupt access to it, or suggest an association with Mass Reaction that does not exist.

Creative work

The artwork, text and code of Mass Reaction are protected by intellectual-property law. Third-party materials, such as the fonts used on this site, remain subject to their own licences. Nothing on this site transfers ownership of that material. Screenshots may be shared for personal, non-commercial purposes such as reviews or showing friends.

Your rights

We work to keep the game and this website available and accurate, but they are provided as they are and may change. Nothing in these terms excludes or limits any right or remedy that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited, including your statutory consumer rights. If we change these terms in a meaningful way, we will update this page and its date.
